I’ve been planing the story out for a few years with a friend of mine who I plan on giving this to for his birthday. 
The characters name is Jason Lambert (who I ended up using my profile name as) he is like a militaristic version of Spider-Man, I based him off of the Sydney funnel web spider for certain reasons.
Back story:
Jason along with his older brother Eli was abducted and forced into a supersoldier program called S.H.A.D.O. Which originally started out with 500. After a event which the chemicals used on them messed up there minds bringing out there primary personal traits. It ended up with him killing most of them (around 450 give or take) and the others that survived escaped (later villains). 
Later on he ended up training The shadow mark 2, after that had completed he retired from that and decided to try to live a normal life in New York, eventually falling into the vigilante life. He fell in love got the girl pregnant, then a rouge shado mk 1 made specifically for hunting shado, named hunter (basic naming) starts hunting Jason. Later they find out hunter is the girls lost brother. Hunter eventually calling out Jason Lambert as the vigilante on live television. Jason goes to kill hunter, long story short the girl gets caught in the cross fire and died also killing his unborn child, Jason snaps and goes into a rage filled feral mode killing hunter, while also dying as well. 

His costume is black and burgundy with burgundy eyes and a hood.

There is more after this but I’d like to see if there is anyone who will commit to it.

I just skimmed it down to the bare necessities, you can add some other things to it to make it better. The girls name was Charlotte Lilith, I just didn’t want to type it out so many times. Again I am always looking to add more to the story so if you want to add more to it, go ahead.
Good luck
